column3: Identify a document: format, pages, scanned or digital, what it holds.
List headings and bookmarks with page anchors. Use before extract.
Locate text: page numbers, counts, and a snippet each. Never a page.
Extract clean text for a page range. Bounded; refuses when too big.
Extract tables as rows. Says whether ruling lines or gaps were used.
Read one page: text, tables, and how each was obtained.
Convert a document to markdown. Refuses when over the token budget.
Build a document from a page selection: merge, split, reorder, rotate.
Convert between formats: pdf, txt, md, html, images.
Optimize a PDF. action: compress, repair, linearize. Reports size change.
Add a searchable text layer. Defaults to the pages that lack one.
PDF security. action: encrypt, decrypt, permissions. Needs a password.
Permanently remove matching content, then verify it cannot be extracted.
Load CSV from a local path or an http(s) URL. Returns the schema.
Load GeoJSON or shapefile. Returns geometry columns and CRS.
Inspect schema, dtypes, nulls, totals. Takes a local path or URL.
Stats for one column: mean median std min max nulls unique top.
Find columns by criteria: has_nulls dtype has_zeros name_contains.
Apply ordered ops to a CSV. ops: see Op Reference below.
Restore a snapshot. No timestamp overwrites with the newest.
Read operation history log for a file. Returns receipt entries.
List apply_patch ops. Omit category to get all, grouped by category.
List sheets in xlsx/ods with row and col counts.
Extract one sheet to CSV. sheet: name or index (default first).
Extract all sheets to separate CSVs in output_dir.
Detect separate tables in a sheet separated by blank rows/cols.
Extract one detected table by index to CSV.
CSV: strip whitespace, lowercase, dedup headers. output_path: write elsewhere.
CSV: drop empty leading/trailing rows and cols. output_path: write elsewhere.
CSV: make row N the header; drop rows above. output_path: write elsewhere.
Forward-fill merged cell regions in xlsx sheet to CSV.
Convert xlsx/ods/csv/json/parquet to csv/json/parquet/excel.
Group by columns and aggregate. agg: sum mean count min max.
Contingency table between two categorical columns.
Multi-dimensional pivot/aggregation table.
Frequency tables with percentages for categorical columns.
Filter rows. Compare a column to 'value' or to 'other_column'.
Sample rows from dataset. methods: random head tail.
Auto-select and run statistical tests: t-test ANOVA chi-square correlation.
Analyze text column: length stats, word freq, pattern detection.
Flag anomalous rows using IQR and/or z-score. Saves flagged CSV.
Compare two CSVs: schema diff, row counts, value changes.
Deep numeric stats: skewness kurtosis percentiles CI MAD CV distribution.
Deep numeric stats: skewness kurtosis percentiles CI MAD CV distribution.
Validate dataset quality: types nulls duplicates ranges. Score 0-100.
Auto-detect column types, dates, IDs, categories with cleaning suggestions.
Scan for outliers + anomalies. method: iqr std both. Flags anomalous rows.
Scan all columns for nulls and zeros. Returns counts, pcts, patterns.
Correlation matrix + top pairs. method: pearson spearman kendall.
Cross-correlate two columns across lags. Returns the curve and its peak.
Run a stat test. 17 available: an unknown 'test' lists them all.
OLS or logistic regression. Returns coefs p-values R2 RMSE diagnostics.
Trend, seasonality and rolling stats. dayfirst: auto true false.
Compare periods: MoM QoQ YoY. dayfirst: auto true false.
Cohort retention matrix. dayfirst: auto true false.
Filter rows + sort. Compare to 'value' or to 'other_column'.
Reshape data. mode: pivot melt split_column combine_columns transpose.
Aggregate data. mode: groupby crosstab value_counts describe window.
Resample by freq: D W M Q Y H. agg: sum mean count min max.
Merge two datasets. how: inner left right outer. Auto-detect join keys.
Stack CSVs. direction: rows (stack) or columns (side by side).
Smart impute missing values using column-type-appropriate strategies.
Run ordered cleaning ops in one call. Single snapshot taken.
Add columns: features bins/date_parts/one_hot/text_length, or derive.
Merge dataset with geo data on location key. Saves enriched result.
EDA summary. mode=minimal|standard|full, sample_n, include. Saves HTML.
Full column profile: stats charts correlations outliers insights.
Histogram + box plot per numeric column, with shape stats. Samples above 5k.
Interactive correlation heatmap for numeric columns. Saves HTML.
Pairwise scatter + histogram matrix for numeric columns. Saves HTML.
Multi-metric bar/line chart. bar needs category_column, line needs date_column.
Generate chart. bar/pie/line/scatter/funnel/radius/geo need category_column.
Geo map: scatter (lat/lon) or choropleth (country/state). Auto-detects.
3D scatter or surface chart. type: scatter_3d surface. Saves HTML.
Rebuild a dashboard with part of its embedded spec changed.
Interactive HTML dashboard. spec overrides detection; sources add tabs.
Export dataset to CSV, Excel, or JSON. Excel gets a README sheet.
Customize existing chart. changes: title labels colors annotations.
Create workspace with data/working/trial/report dirs.
Open workspace. Returns file aliases, pipeline history, active file.
Add file to workspace with alias. stage: raw working trial output.
List all workspace files with alias, stage, size, row count.
Save named pipeline template. ops: list of apply_patch op dicts.
Execute saved pipeline on file alias. Creates new output alias.
Find files by name/content. content is literal unless regex=True.
Read file content, tree, metadata, or diff. Bounded always.
Write, edit, move, copy, download a URL, restore. Delete needs a token.
Build/query/list file index or read operation receipt history.
Disk usage, permissions, symlink info, or snapshot version list.
Create or extract zip/tar.gz. path=archive, target=what goes in it.
Evaluate arithmetic expression. Returns numeric result and steps.
Convert value between units. Returns converted result.
Solve equation for variable. Returns list of solutions.
Simplify algebraic expression. Returns simplified form.
Differentiate expression. Returns derivative.
Integrate expression. Returns indefinite or definite integral.
Compute descriptive statistics for a dataset. Returns summary.
Evaluate LaTeX formula with variable substitution. Returns result.
Web search (SearXNG/DDG/Brave). Returns <=10 hits.
Probe URL once, return detected mode + status.
Peek URL: title + first ~500 chars. No DB write.
Fetch + index URL. Returns surgical receipt.
Read one row from pages by URL.
Engine health: pools, breaker, db.
Current date, time, day-of-week, and timezone.
Extract elements by CSS/XPath/text/regex selector.
List tables + row counts. Surgical.
FTS5 search across pages/news/files. <=10 rows.
SELECT-only SQL (parameterless). Bounded.
Export table to CSV/JSON. Returns the path, never the rows.
Per-table row counts + db_bytes.
Inspect dataset schema, row count, dtypes, null summary.
Profile one column. Returns stats, null count, top values.
Search columns: dtype numeric/categorical/bool/datetime. Names only.
Read bounded row slice. Max rows enforced by hardware mode.
Train classifier on CSV. model: lr svm rf dtc knn nb xgb.
Train regressor on CSV. model: lir pr lar rr dtr rfr xgb.
Run predictions with saved model. Returns bounded prediction list.
Restore file/model to previous snapshot. Empty timestamp = list.
Predict on one record: a JSON string or an object. No CSV needed.
List saved .pkl models. Empty scans the server's model output dir.
Split CSV into train/test CSV files and save both.
Apply preprocessing ops to dataset. Snapshot before write.
Detect outliers in columns. feature_columns= also accepted. iqr or std.
Train with K-fold CV. Returns per-fold and mean scores.
Train multiple models, return sorted comparison table.
Cluster dataset. algorithm: kmeans meanshift dbscan.
Read operation history for a file. Returns log entries.
Generate interactive HTML EDA report. theme: light dark.
Find optimal K via elbow + silhouette. Saves HTML chart.
Detect anomalies. method: isolation_forest lof.
Quality score 0-100, typed alerts. Pass target_column for leakage.
Score model on a labeled CSV, flag leakage. test_file_path= or file_path=.
Predict all rows, save to CSV. No row limit. Returns output path.
Tune hyperparameters via grid or random search. search: grid random.
Export model + manifest. Pickle carries a 32-byte signature prefix.
Model metrics, feature importance, confusion matrix. Map summarised.
Generate Plotly HTML profile report for a dataset.
Reduce dimensions with PCA or ICA. Saves reduced dataset.
Generate HTML report: metrics, confusion matrix, feature importance.
Plot ROC curve for classifier. Saves interactive HTML.
Plot train vs val score by training size. HTML output.
Scatter predicted vs actual for regression. HTML output.
Generate HTML cluster visualization with PCA scatter and profile.
Return headings and paragraph indices — structural skeleton.
Return section tree index. Zero paragraph content returned.
Fetch one addressed section or paragraph. address: '§1' or '§1.p3'.
Read full doc. Use get_document_index for large files (>10 pages).
Return one paragraph by paragraph_index, with full run detail. index= ok.
Return bounded paragraph range. Max 50 paragraphs.
Scan paragraphs for matching text. Returns only matches.
Find text and replace in-place, preserving run formatting.
Insert paragraph after index N. -1 inserts before the first paragraph.
Delete a paragraph by index or by matching text content.
Append a new paragraph at the end of the document.
Return version snapshot history for a document.
Restore document to a previous snapshot. Optionally create git branch.
Compare two document versions. timestamp_b defaults to current file.
Show recent tool operations on this file. last_n: how many to show.
Apply Heading 1-6 style to paragraph N. level must be 1-6.
Font on paragraph N: name size bold italic color(hex) spacing.
Apply named style from document gallery to paragraph N.
Insert image into paragraph N. Formats: PNG, JPG, GIF, BMP, TIFF.
Set page margins in cm (top/bottom/left/right) for all sections.
Set header/footer. location: header footer. page_numbers adds PAGE.
Export .docx to PDF (needs Word/LibreOffice). return_content=bytes.
Create blank .docx. return_content=True embeds file bytes (remote).
Create .docx from list of {text, style} paragraph dicts.
Create structured .docx from [{heading, body, image}] sections.
Block kinds create_from_blocks accepts, with keys and an example each.
Typed blocks to a .docx. Call list_block_kinds() for the 12 kinds.
Copy template .docx, fill {key: value} substitutions, save.
Create a formatted business letter .docx.
Merge multiple .docx files into one document.
Generate N .docx files from a template + list of {key:value} dicts.
List all tables with row/column dimensions.
Return the full 2-D cell array. Args: table_index (0-based).
Scan all table cells for matching text. Returns coordinates.
Return one table row. Args: table_index, row (both 0-based).
Write text to one cell. Args: table_index, row, col, text.
Append a row. Args: table_index, data (list of cell strings).
Remove a row; rows below shift up. Args: table_index, row.
Insert table after paragraph N (-1 = first). Args: rows, cols, data.
Remove one table entirely. Args: table_index (0-based).
Shade/format cells. Hex colors. row/col -1 = all. band_fill stripes.
Read presentation index: slides, layouts, and structure.
Read all shapes on one slide with name, type, and text.
Search all slides for query text, return matching shapes.
Return text of all shapes on one slide (no formatting).
Replace shape text using run-level editing.
Append a slide with given layout, title, and body text.
Remove a slide by index.
Move a slide from one position to another.
Add a text box to a slide at given position in inches.
Compare two presentation versions by snapshot timestamp.
Set slide background to color/image. slide_index -1 = all slides.
Set font on a shape. bold: "true", "false" or "" to leave.
Insert a table with row/col data on a slide.
Add chart to slide. type: bar, line, pie. data: {categories, series}.
Copy slide N to position insert_at (-1 = append at end).
Export .pptx to PDF (needs LibreOffice/PowerPoint). Can embed bytes.
Add the same image (logo/watermark) to every slide at given position.
Set font on all slides. bold: "true", "false" or "" to leave.
Create blank .pptx w/ title slide. return_content=True embeds bytes.
Create .pptx from [{title, content, layout}] slide list.
Create .pptx deck from title + [{heading, bullets}] list.
Copy .pptx template, fill {key: value} substitutions, save.
Create a meeting agenda .pptx from {topic,duration,owner} items.
Convert a Word document outline into a PowerPoint presentation.
List all sheets with row and column dimensions.
Return sheet dimensions, header row, and first-column sample.
Return value, formula, and data type for one cell.
Return 2D cell array for range. Max 200 cells.
Scan cells for text matching query. Returns matching addresses.
Write a value to a single cell by address.
Write a 2D list of values starting at start_cell.
Insert empty row at row_index (1-based), shifting rows down.
Remove row at row_index (1-based), shifting remaining rows up.
Create a new worksheet with an optional name.
Sort sheet rows by column. column='A'. has_header skips row 1.
Rename sheet_name to new_name. old_name= accepted for sheet_name.
Find duplicate values in a column. Returns rows where value repeats.
Copy sheet_name to a new sheet new_name. source_sheet=/new_sheet_name= ok.
Create chart from data range. type: bar, line, pie, area, scatter.
Remove chart by zero-based index from sheet.
Update chart title and/or data range by index.
Sum values per rows group. cols optional: adds a second axis.
Style a cell: font, fill, format. bold: "true"/"false"/"".
Write formula to cell. Formula must start with '='.
Define a named range in the workbook.
Apply color rule to range. rule: gt/lt/between/eq. color: green/red/yellow/blue.
Add data validation to range. type: list, decimal, whole.
Freeze rows/columns at cell. Empty string to unfreeze.
Enable AutoFilter on header row range.
Fill formula down from start_cell to end_row, adjusting row refs.
Add SUM/AVERAGE/COUNT/MAX/MIN formula for a range into sum_cell.
Replace formulas with their calculated values in a range.
Create blank .xlsx. return_content=True embeds file bytes (remote).
Create .xlsx from headers+rows. return_content=True embeds bytes.
Multi-sheet .xlsx from [{name,headers,rows}], plus a Cover sheet.
Copy .xlsx template, fill {key: value} substitutions, save.
Import a CSV file into a new Excel workbook.
Create invoice .xlsx: items, totals, tax formula. tax_rate 0-1.
